messages:
Elle: Heads-up — CardioWorks submitted a vendor risk form and marked three items as blockers for their renewal: (A) need SOC2 evidence or SOC2 letter, (B) exact subprocessors list with regions, (C) confirmation of how we treat PHI when creating embeddings. They want answers by COB Thursday or procurement will hold payments.

Priya: Noted. I'll flag renewal risk in Salesforce and ping the AM.

Devin: Can someone pull the redacted SOC2 and a subprocessors export? I can assemble an evidence zip and draft a short technical FAQ about embeddings.

Sanjay: I can export subprocessors CSV and SOC2 letter (redacted). Reminder: we only disclose full SOC2 report under NDA + signed Data Processing Agreement if they request.

Devin: For PHI + embeddings we have three customer-facing options:
- Private deployment with customer KMS (recommended)
- Hosted with pseudonymization pre-ingest (customer side)
- Hosted with our transform pipeline (opt-in; we can enable for the tenant)
I'll write a one-pager that explains retention windows, hashing, salted identifiers, and logging.

Elle: Procurement also asked: do embeddings include tenant IDs in metadata? and can we support deletion requests for embeddings?

Devin: Short answers: we do not persist raw PII fields in embedding vectors. Metadata may contain a tenant_id but customer identifiers can be stripped on request. Embeddings retention policy: default 30d sliding window for ephemeral indexes; persistent storage only with explicit agreement. Deletion: yes, we support per-tenant deletion APIs and can process data-removal tickets with a 48h SLA for Hosted customers, faster for Dedicated/Private.

Sanjay: Command snippet for deletion we share with customers:```bash
# delete embeddings for tenant
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/\$TENANT_ID/embeddings/delete -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY"
```

Devin: For pseudonymization sample (for procurement FAQ) I'll include this Python pattern:```python
# client-side pseudonymization example
def redact(text):
    text = re.sub(r"\\b(\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4})\\b", "<SSN>", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\\b(\\d{16})\\b", "<CC>", text)
    return text

doc = redact(raw_text)
vec = client.embed(doc)
store(vec)
```

Priya: AM wants to know if we can provide a signed DPA and whether legal will accept CardioWorks' redline.

LegalBot: DPA template available; custom redlines need review. Typical turnaround: 2 business days for standard redline; expedited review may be possible but requires SOC2 NDA to be sent first.

Elle: OK — plan of attack: (1) Send DPA template + request any redlines (owner: Priya for AM coordination), (2) Request NDA via secure link for SOC2 access (owner: Devin), (3) Attach redacted SOC2 letter + subprocessors CSV (owner: Sanjay), (4) Provide the embeddings FAQ + code snippets (owner: Devin). Deadline: try to get initial package to procurement within 24 hours to avoid renewal hold.

Devin: I'll generate the FAQ and evidence bundle. Question: do we have a standard phrasing that procurement prefers about logging and access controls for embeddings storage?

Sanjay: Use standard security blurb: role-based access, audit logs retained 90d by default, access only via service accounts, and SOC2 controls cover operational access to storage. I'll paste the blurb into the FAQ.

Devin: Draft outbound message to procurement (will paste here before sending): "Hi — attached redacted SOC2 letter, subprocessors CSV, DPA template. Please sign the NDA for full SOC2 access. See included FAQ about embeddings retention and pseudonymization. Happy to schedule a technical call tomorrow — suggested attendees: SRE (Sanjay), Solutions Eng (Devin), AM (Priya)."

Elle: Sounds good. Also note: CardioWorks put a checkbox for 'we will require pseudonymization at rest' — if they insist on at-rest pseudonymization for hosted, we'll recommend private deployment. Add that to the outbound.

Priya: AM asked to be cc'd and wants the renewal-risk note in the email.

Onboarding Bot: Status update -> vendor-form: received; evidence-bundle: in progress (owner: Devin); NDA: not requested; DPA: template attached (legal pending); renewal-risk: high.

Devin: Sending initial package now. Posting copy below once sent.

Devin: OUTBOUND (to procurement): "Attached: redacted SOC2 letter (PDF), subprocessors.csv, DPA template. Next steps: please sign NDA via https://redwood.secure/nda to request full SOC2 report; review DPA and send redlines; see FAQ on embeddings and deletion. If you'd like a technical call, propose 30m tomorrow at 10am PST. - Devin"

Elle: Thanks. Priya please escalate renewal risk in Salesforce and schedule follow-up with AM.

Priya: Done — Salesforce note updated, AM pinged, and I scheduled a hold-until meeting for Friday morning.

Sanjay: SOC2 access: once NDA is signed, I'll share the auditor letter and the scoped controls summary.

Devin: Closing loop here — evidence bundle sent and ticket updated. Will monitor procurement response and loop in Legal if they send DPA redlines. :thumbsup:
